accept-stale-leader.what: a follower treats AppendEntries of an earlier term as coming from its leader

ack-before-durable.what: answers AppendEntries before the entry is durable

ack-old-term.what: a follower stores the entry of an AppendEntries of an earlier term

candidate-asks-before-durable.what: a candidate asks for votes before its vote for itself is durable

commit-by-counting.what: commits an entry of an earlier term by counting replicas (Figure 8)

commit-unchecked-suffix.what: a follower commits up to its own last entry, not the last one the leader confirmed

entry-before-cut.what: a follower writes the replacing entry before it cuts the conflicting suffix

follower-length-before-entry.what: a follower writes the new length before the entry it covers

leader-counts-undurable-self.what: a leader counts its own copy of an entry the moment it appends it

leader-overwrites-last.what: a leader puts a new entry in the place of its last one

length-before-entry.what: a leader writes the new length before the entry it covers

local-get.what: a leader answers a get from its own state without confirming leadership

no-prev-term-check.what: a follower accepts AppendEntries without comparing prevLogTerm

put-twice.what: executes every copy of a put that a client's retries left in the log

recovery-forgets-vote.what: a restarted server has no vote, whatever its disk says

recovery-never-completes.what: a server that restarts with entries on its disk reads past the last one

self-counts-before-durable.what: a leader counts its whole log, durable or not, when an acknowledgement arrives

stale-ack-counted.what: a leader counts an acknowledgement that was given in an earlier term

stale-vote-counted.what: a candidate counts a vote that was granted in an earlier term

vote-before-durable.what: answers a vote request before votedFor is durable

vote-without-log-check.what: grants a vote without the up-to-date check (5.4.1)

votes-twice.what: grants a vote in a term in which it already voted for another server
